name: Torn Paper Love
summary: Turn couple photos into a 4:3 torn-paper love edit cut on the beat, with ransom-note letters, as a new editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Requires Panel runScript and Draft authoring. Music previews and your own music use the ffmpeg built into Selects; nothing else to install.

inputs.label: Select photos or clips
inputs.hint: Photos of the two of you; clips fill in when there are too few photos.

prepare: Photos of the two of you, at least 3
Any clips you add analyzed first, at least 1.5 seconds long
